title: Italian Wonton Puff Pastry
description: A unique Italian-inspired appetizer using wonton wrappers as a pastry substitute.
instructions: Roll out puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch. Cut into 2-inch squares.
Place a wonton wrapper on each square, pressing edges to seal.
Brush edges with puff pastry and press to seal. Cut a small slit on top.
Arrange wontons on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, cook chow mein noodles according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix chow mein sauce and cooked noodles. Stir until combined.
Serve wontons on a platter with chow mein sauce mixture on the side.
Garnish with chopped scallions or chives if desired.
